text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambian newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Nurses at Lusaka's University Teaching Hospital on Monday resumed a strike to push for improved conditions of service. At the same time, workers at the state-run Medical Stores in Lusaka, and the central post office workers in the northern town of Nola, went on strike for more pay.

- The Fire Services Assocaition of Zambia said Zambia was a fire disaster region because of poor fire fighting services. Association chief Golden Lukama said only one fire station in the capital was fully operational.
- The Zambian peace keeping contigent in Angola has been honoured as the best peace keeping force there, defence minister Ben Mwila said on Monday.
